title: perf: Overhaul `_cmpkey` to remove use of custom objects

verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: Unpickling a previously pickled Version object fails with a ModuleNotFoundError after a refactor that only claims to improve comparison performance and keep internal backward compatibility. No changelog, test, or documentation mentions breaking pickle compatibility, which callers reasonably rely on.
evidence: # Backward compatibility for internals before 26.0. Do not use.
Override comparison methods to use direct _key_cache access... This is faster than property access, especially before Python 3.12
@_deprecated("Version._version is private and will be removed soon")

@_deprecated("Version._version is private and will be removed soon")
    def _version(self, value: _Version) -> None:

# Backward compatibility for internals before 26.0. Do not use.
class _Version(NamedTuple):

if other._key_cache is None:
                other._key_cache = _cmpkey(
                    other._epoch,
                    other._release,
                    other._pre,
                    other._post,
                    other._dev,
                    other._local,
                )
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["0"], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.ModuleNotFoundError.
